title: ImageDescription
description: Structured descriptions of each photo attached to a complaint. One entry per photo, in the same order as user_pics.

complaint_id.description: References the complaint the photos belong to

caption.description: One-sentence factual description of what the photo shows

objects.description: Relevant objects visible in the photo (e.g. 'tubería', 'enchufe', 'cartel')

damage_indicators.description: Visual signs of damage or wear (e.g. 'humedad', 'óxido', 'cristal roto')

not_in_text.description: True when the photo shows something the complaint text does not mention
